title: Archery Expansion Arrows Compatibility Textures (Ice and Fire!)
description: A simple texture pack that allows more arrows to be used with archery expansion without defaulting to the vanilla texture!
body:
Hello! This a simple texture pack for the 1.20.1 archery expansion! This pack adds textures for modded arrows so that they can fit within archery expansion's bows!

Currently supports all arrows from Ice and Fire: Dragons! Looking for more arrows to add and will be updated as I add more!

(Note: I made no textures here on my own!! All textures are retooled versions of the original textures from their respective mods!! All I did was edit them to fit better!!)

[Curseforge!](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/archery-expansion-arrows-compatibility-textures)
